Cumulative is 58,081.31 against a Last-Report 54,305.00 (54,305.00 + 3,776.31 = 58,081.31 exactly), so the schedule is PERIOD-scoped behind a cumulative cover -> period-exact. 2026 3-line form: one combined contributions cell, no separate <=$50 aggregate, so the line-1/line-2 basis rule does not apply. expenditures.anchor: the schedule's own printed 'Total' row on p3, 5,710.14, which is also the cover's 'This Report' Total Campaign Expenditures cell (5,710.14)
expenditures.detail: TRACED FILER-ARITHMETIC DELTA of 9.00. The 18 rows printed on p3 sum to 5,719.14: the thirteen small online rows (3.10 + 5.90 + 2.00 + 1.70 + 2.00 + 4.00 + 0.61 + 0.61 + 2.00 + 4.00 + 3.00 + 0.87 + 3.00) = 32.79, plus 281.49 + 96.24 + 2,000.00 + 600.00 + 2,708.62 = 5,686.35, giving 5,719.14. The filer's own Total prints 5,710.14, i.e. 9.00 LESS than his own rows. The 9.00 is not a misread: the amount column was OCR'd cell-by-cell against the 20 measured bands and every one of the 18 row figures plus the Total came back as transcribed, and the Total cell was then re-cropped tight at 900 dpi and renders '5,710.14' unambiguously. Two page-level readings both produce exactly 9.00 and the sheet does not distinguish them: (a) the Total omits the first two rows, the 5/22 and 5/26 Credit Fees, which are 3.10 + 5.90 = 9.00 exactly; (b) a single-digit keying slip in the units place of the Total itself (5,719.14 -> 5,710.14). Nothing was adjusted: the 18 rows are retained verbatim and the delta is the FILER's. The rest of his arithmetic is internally consistent on his own figure - 3,776.31 - 5,710.14 = -1,933.83, the printed This-Report ending balance in parentheses, and 34,353.53 + 5,710.14 = 40,063.67, the printed Cumulative - so the cover and the schedule agree with each other and only the rows disagree. Scope: this is the period ledger behind a cumulative cover (Last Report 34,353.53 is non-zero), so had it closed it would have closed period-exact. Row-count gate: 20 measured bands = 18 data rows + one blank row + the Total row, matching the 18 rows read.

itemized.notes: Richard A. Hyer, Weber County Commissioner seat a, 2026 cycle; June 16 Primary Election report, signed 6-16-2026, clerk RECEIVED stamp JUN 16 2026. Three pages: p1 the TYPED 2026 cover (the 'June 16 - Primary Election' line is marked with a handwritten 'xx' in the left margin rather than a checkbox), p2 a 'Contributions' grid and p3 an 'Expenditures' grid - both the filer's own spreadsheet tables, not Weber's Form A / Form B, with the schedule name HANDWRITTEN above each table and no column headers printed at all. Column order was assigned from the data itself: p2 is date | name | city | amount, p3 is date | payee | purpose | city | amount (the purpose column carries Marketing/marketing/consulting and the city column carries online/Online/ogden/Ogden). NO STATE COLUMN EXISTS on either sheet, so donor_state is honestly BLANK on 14 of 15 contribution rows - left that way by the FILER, not redacted by the county; the one exception is Dale England, where the filer wrote 'Manson, Wa' inside the city cell. NO STREET ADDRESS is printed anywhere on either schedule, so there was nothing to withhold under PRIVACY on the itemized pages; the county DID redact the candidate's own street address and home/office phone on the p1 cover (solid black boxes), which is a county redaction and a different fact. The expenditure side does NOT close - see recon.expenditures.detail for the traced 9.00 filer delta. Filer spellings kept verbatim: 'FaceBook' on one row and 'Facebook' on the others, 'homedepot', 'Pleasantview'. The first contribution row is the filer's own 'Fraud Adjustment' 16.05, which he reported as a contribution and included in his Total.
